title: active-record.jsonc
description: The project's databases and their adapter, which the active-record command reads. `npx active-record init` writes it.

$schema.description: This schema, for an editor to complete and check the file's keys.

databases.description: Each database by its binding: the name the Worker's env, and the generated schema, give it.

d1.description: A D1 database. Its migrations folder and the rest come from its d1_databases entry in the Wrangler config beside this file.

pg.description: A Postgres database. `${NAME}` in a connection string reads the variable NAME from the environment.

migrationsDir.description: Its migrations folder, relative to this file.

url.description: The local database: what migrate and the console use.

schemaUrl.description: A server the schema may be read on, for an extension PGlite doesn't have.
